prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for single-test change kinds (adoption layout, finish hint/layout, home redesign, sign_in hint/redesign/reorder).
Redesigning adoption screens (adoption, redesign) proved helpful and delivered winning tests.
Copy changes on the path selection screen (choose_path, copy) consistently hurt performance.
Adding new screens at the finish step (finish, new_screen) showed no clear positive effect and hurt performance.
Notification toggles (home, notification) and waiting screen info (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect.
Predictions were consistently higher than the noise-corrected measured results.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Carousel redesign for friend selection screen: Redesign the pet selection screen into a carousel layout with interactive preview elements to make exploring pet options easier. (why: Earlier lessons show redesigning adoption screens delivered winning tests and improved conversion across the pet selection funnel.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder sign-in prior to adoption certificate screen: Shift sign-in directly before adoption certificate creation so account state is established before official pet registration. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again later; securing account authentication before certificate issuing reduces loss of account state.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] Pet personality trait selection screen: Insert a new screen after pet pick allowing users to set desktop personality traits (playful, calm, active) before completing adoption. (why: Adoption funnel stage has an 89s median time and 73.8% conversion; adding engaging customization before photo upload boosts adoption motivation.)
3: [choose_path, redesign] Two-column layout redesign for path selection: Redesign the path selection screen into a two-column layout comparing preset vs custom creation visually without changing copy. (why: Path selection has a 76.2% conversion and very long tail (mean 514s); visual screen redesign improves clarity without suffering from negative copy test history.)
4: [adoption, new_flow] Art style selection flow before custom photo upload: Add an art style preset sub-flow screen before photo upload so custom pet creation has clear visual direction. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failing or looking wrong; guiding aesthetic pre-selection improves output quality and user confidence.)
5: [adoption, incentive] Official adoption seal badge incentive: Display an official digital adoption seal badge component on the adoption certificate screen upon entering pet details. (why: Certificate creation is a high-intent step in adoption; visual completion incentives reinforce ownership and progress.)
6: [home, layout] Carousel layout for desktop loading waiting screen: Switch the waiting screen layout to carousel to show rotating tips and pet visual previews while generation runs. (why: Home waiting stage has a median 201s / mean 2336s duration where users stall before reaching the desktop.)
7: [home, redesign] Full bleed layout redesign for desktop pet initialization screen: Redesign the waiting screen into a full bleed visual canvas showing active setup animations. (why: 3 support tickets reported pet not showing on desktop or app failing to open; immersive setup visual reduces drop-off during 200s+ wait.)
8: [finish, copy] Desktop interaction control copy on intro finish screen: Update headline and body on the final home intro screen to explicitly explain click, right-click, and drag controls for the pet. (why: Finish step drops to 64.8% and 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet post-onboarding.)

scores.note: Adoption redesigns have proven track record (+2.7% over 3 tests), though creating interactive carousel elements requires new UI work.

Choose_path redesigns historically showed negative lift (-1.6% across 2 tests).
3 support tickets back the problem, but adding a sub-flow screen risks drop-off during adoption.
Low cost visual enhancement targeting adoption completion motivation.
